reservoir_ep21_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_001.text: On One Thousand Three Hundred Forty, Deng kept Yue's preparation modest even after the two completed qualifying pairs. The last condition concerned interrupted sleep, whose original failure had ended with a partial task and a real headache. Those facts stayed in their actual record. She could not make the upcoming night safe by declaring herself a different person. She could bring recovered practice, full stops and a funded independent follow-up. The lesson began with grounding and ended within its finite known demand, leaving ordinary rest as a real part of the preparation.

reservoir_ep21_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_002.text: Jing prepared an accepted quiet comparison after current sleep and morning activity. Seventy-three measured usable before the quarter-unit sample, leaving seventy-two and three quarters afterward. Compatibility measured ninety-two and one quarter percent. Recorded safe input between the movement follow-up and this comparison supplied the current practice source within the old ceiling. The present quantity did not promise what would remain after the registered interrupted night. Yue welcomed it and left the last trial's blank line empty. A good quiet morning still needed to live through the different one.

reservoir_ep21_003.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_003.text: Mei reviewed the registered ordinary sleep interruption again. The attendant would wake Yue at the agreed interval for a bounded twenty-minute ordinary task, record its actual start and end, then allow her to return to bed. Actual return to sleep and morning recovery would be reported. No vigil, repeated deprivation or dangerous exhaustion belonged to the condition. An unsuitable starting state could postpone the trial, and a failed response would stop it. The local certificate required balance under an ordinary changed night, not proof that a candidate could make harm look impressive.

reservoir_ep21_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_004.text: Yue asked whether wanting the certificate too much could itself disqualify her. Mei said desire was not the measured condition. Its effect on actual attention and the stop could matter. A candidate could want advancement and still release correctly, or speak calmly while delaying the stop. Yue understood through the original failure's urge to finish. The examination would observe the present behavior and current comparison. She did not need to manufacture indifference before the interrupted night, which made the honest wish for a favorable result easier to carry into preparation.

reservoir_ep21_005.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_005.text: At lunch Fu asked whether she wanted quiet company before the last condition. Yue accepted a short meal and no prediction. Fu told her about the new boot cord's first loose end, which her brother had actually retied without claiming a historical crisis. The small ordinary repair made Yue laugh. Their friendship could remain about food, songs and specific requests while the certificate waited. The last next-day appointment had a real source and date. The mother's ordinary household had its own present tasks. Nobody needed to turn tonight's soup into a rehearsal of eventual triumph.

reservoir_ep21_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_006.text: On Forty-one Deng practiced hearing the actual stop after a familiar low set, with no changed sleep imposed. Yue reported comfortable current recovery and no headache. Each ordinary breath stayed within an eighth unit, and the familiar four-breath total never exceeded half. At one pause she anticipated the next instruction and ended early. The useful error stayed in the teaching note. A sound later certificate would not mean this habit had vanished from every future room. It would describe actual balanced practice under the conditions this local board had tested.

reservoir_ep21_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_007.text: Jing's father brought the finished bean cloth to the garden because he now wished to praise its green without admitting the change in his opinion. Jing let him find the words. Yue listened and resisted offering a joke before he finished. He said the cloth looked like a garden that could use better soil. Jing accepted that peculiar compliment. They laughed afterward. An ordinary person's awkward affection deserved time to arrive in its own language. Yue wanted to preserve that kind of attention during a task whose instrument could otherwise absorb every useful part of the room.

reservoir_ep21_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_008.text: On Forty-two the ordinary sleep attendant confirmed the actual waking method and record with Yue. She would knock, receive the agreed ordinary answer and observe the bounded task without adding cultivation demand. The timing source was checked against the room's ordinary clock before the night. The daughter from the water households had once taught Yue how clocks could differ. That remembered public lesson guided a present preparation question, not a private diary copied into another purpose. The attendant accepted the checked method and left the room for its normal evening use.

reservoir_ep21_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_009.text: Yue looked at the bed and felt irritation that such an ordinary object would carry the last difficult condition. A bed should have been refuge after the work, not part of its evidence. Deng said the reservoir was meant to survive the life in which beds sometimes contained interruptions. He did not tell her to enjoy the test. She could dislike its ordinary change and still consent to its bounded purpose. The planned night had recovery and a next-day appointment, with actual observers rather than an instruction to hide fatigue until a promising number appeared.

reservoir_ep21_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_010.text: At supper Tian asked whether the river onion should have a sleeping cap. Yue said it might refuse because its ears would complicate the fitting. Jing offered to prepare an ordinary cloth scrap and withdrew when Tian proposed a decorative border. They made a small paper cap instead. Yue laughed and left the picture at the kitchen table. It would not enter the registered room as a charm or a demand for applause. The joke had performed its real ordinary work already: company at a meal before a night she feared.

reservoir_ep21_011.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_011.text: On Forty-three, Mei checked the actual prepared sample sequence. As in the other qualifying trials, the quarter-unit total would be split into an eighth before the task and an eighth after its changed response. The familiar actual application cost would remain half a unit, with no greater throughput or useful output. The final usable threshold would be read after those real costs and the actual night's condition. The next morning would take its own quarter-unit sample. Yue repeated the subtraction without selecting the best pre-sample number to make the last condition look passed.

reservoir_ep21_012.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_012.text: Jing also confirmed the remaining four coppers in the formal next-day clinical line. The first eight had actually paid the temperature and movement follow-ups. This last appointment would deliver its agreed condition preparation and actual next-day review on Forty-nine. It was distinct from the post-failure care already closed months earlier. A favorable trial would still need the real appointment. Yue could fail without losing Mei's independent fee, and pass without receiving a higher application ceiling. The course had purchased an honest local decision within its stated scope.

reservoir_ep21_013.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_013.text: On Forty-four Deng kept the ordinary lesson short. Yue had been thinking about the last actual next morning rather than the interrupted night itself. He asked her to return attention to today's low marker before intake. She grounded and completed one familiar safe set, then released fully. The current teaching response remained useful and finite. She felt tempted to ask for a private prediction. Deng offered none. He could name improved habits he had actually seen; Mei would compare the registered changed condition independently when its real date arrived.

reservoir_ep21_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_014.text: Fu invited Yue to the sound garden path after the lesson, with no song or project report required. They stopped by the painted bird and found its maker had added a small basket beneath it. Tian had apparently negotiated successfully at last. Fu said the child had approved only because the basket looked unlikely to fly. Yue laughed and accepted the maker's ordinary joke. The wrist's current care restrictions had their own actual review, and art had its own owner. A pleasant garden did not need to become evidence that every painful event had ended perfectly.

reservoir_ep21_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_015.text: On Forty-five the ordinary clinician heard Yue's current sleep, appetite, headache and shoulder account under the agreed final-check preparation. No new concern required postponing the bounded night. The existing shoulder range remained unchanged. The starting state on Forty-eight would still decide whether the actual trial proceeded, since a present review could not promise a future body. Yue understood. She would report an unsuitable morning if it occurred. Two passed pairs and an eager room could not make it acceptable to conceal exhaustion in order to keep a planned certificate date.

reservoir_ep21_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_016.text: The pump candidate asked whether she feared disappointing Mei after so much independent work. Yue said the fee had bought an honest result, and she still sometimes wanted the examiner to be pleased. He understood the difference between the contract and the ordinary feeling. They discussed the kitchen recipe instead of turning that feeling into another hidden requirement. The cook had confirmed its salt and actually prepared it well. Ordinary competent work remained reassuring even when it answered no cultivation question. Yue ate and left the last condition's uncertainty available for its actual evidence.

reservoir_ep21_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_017.text: On Forty-six Deng supervised the final modest familiar sets before the registered night. Their recorded input stayed within the old ceiling, with full grounding and no extra load. The actual later starting measurement would say what remained usable after loss, activity and sleep. Yue did not add every gross input to the current ledger as if none had been consumed. She ended on time and retained ordinary recovery. Jing's prepared sleeves stayed in custody. Mei's stop decision remained independent. The room had enough reliable work around it without a secret extra set performed to make everybody's preparation seem worthwhile.

reservoir_ep21_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_018.text: That evening Yue wrote a private sentence beside the blank final record: if the task stops, say where. She remembered how easily the original partial two-breath application had become 'almost complete' in the first version of her explanation. A full stop had kept that failure from escalating. It would remain useful if needed again. She did not rehearse failure to make herself immune to disappointment. She preserved language she could use honestly under it. Then she put the paper away and enjoyed an ordinary quiet supper with Fu.

reservoir_ep21_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_019.text: On One Thousand Three Hundred Forty-seven, the registered night began at the agreed ordinary bedtime. Yue ate the actual course supper and prepared the low bedside items without reaching above her shoulder range. She went to bed at twenty-two and recorded ordinary sleep onset at twenty-two-ten. No intake practice was performed in bed. The attendant had the checked timing source and bounded task. Yue wanted the night to go well and could not supervise the sleeping part into obedience. She let the first real sleep arrive rather than remain awake pretending to have conquered its uncertainty.

reservoir_ep21_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_020.text: At two in the morning, the attendant knocked at the registered interval. Yue woke and completed the agreed ordinary twenty-minute task with no cultivation application added. Its actual start and end were recorded. She returned to bed at two-twenty and reported actual return to sleep at two-forty-seven. The delay belonged to the changed night instead of being hidden inside the nominal twenty-minute interruption. She woke ordinarily at seven-thirty. The two real sleep periods totaled eight hours and thirty-three minutes, with forty-seven actual waking minutes between them.

reservoir_ep21_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_021.text: On One Thousand Three Hundred Forty-eight, the starting review found Yue recovered for the registered bounded trial. She reported the actual interruption, return-to-sleep delay and present condition, with no headache or new shoulder pain. The existing low-load range remained. Jing's accepted blank settled before the personal sample. The usable starting inventory after that actual changed night and ordinary morning activity measured seventy-three. The first eighth-unit sample left seventy-two and seven eighths. The final eighth would follow the actual response, preserving the registered quarter-unit total before the threshold was read.

reservoir_ep21_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_022.text: Yue began the familiar four-breath application within the old maximum eighth-unit input per ordinary breath. The actual half-unit total left seventy-two and three eighths before the final sample. Its already measured useful output remained a quarter unit, with no shielding, healing or new range claimed. At the pause that had failed months earlier, she heard the actual ordinary signal without rushing to finish something impressive. She completed the agreed full grounded release. The interrupted night had changed her morning, but the reservoir retained its registered balance through the task and stop.

reservoir_exam_trial_c.speaker: narrator
reservoir_exam_trial_c.text: Jing withdrew the second eighth-unit sample and completed the independent comparison. Seventy-two and a quarter remained actually usable after the quarter-unit total sampling, half-unit task, changed sleep and morning activity. The compatible portion measured ninety-two and one quarter percent. The response had stayed balanced within the local criterion, with no hidden drift, additional draw or unfinished breath called complete. The changed-sleep trial met its preregistered conditions on this third separately recovered date. Mei signed the completed trial and kept the certificate pending its real next-day check.

reservoir_ep21_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_024.text: Yue remained seated while the prepared sleeve returned to safe custody. She felt relief so strong that the ordinary room looked unfamiliar for a moment. Deng asked her to describe the stop rather than explain the whole future. She said the pause had stayed available even while she wanted the result. The original headache had not returned. These were actual present observations beside the independent trace, not permission for another application. She stood only after grounding settled and kept the shoulder within its old range. Tomorrow would still need its own ordinary body and sample.

reservoir_ep21_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_025.text: Mei read the final trial's inventory aloud with Yue: seventy-three starting, an eighth sampled, half a unit used, another eighth sampled, seventy-two and a quarter remaining. The measured trial value belonged to Forty-eight and would not be rewritten by whatever tomorrow found. The actual next-day tissue, reserve and zero-draw control check still lay ahead. Yue remained stage seven until the independent full-series decision. Three good trials were encouraging, and the registered evidence required three actual next mornings as well. The missing one would not be supplied by relief.

reservoir_ep21_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_026.text: At lunch Tian offered the river onion's sleeping-cap picture and admitted the ears did not fit. Yue laughed and accepted the private scrap after the instrument work ended. Fu asked whether she wanted to talk about the actual night. She said she wanted food first. The ordinary answer delighted both friends. The kitchen meal belonged to its actual finite source, and nobody treated the remaining formal clinic money as a celebration purse. Yue had completed a difficult trial and could eat as a hungry person while its required next day remained incomplete.

reservoir_ep21_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_027.text: That afternoon she followed the agreed ordinary recovery plan, with no secret intake added to protect the favorable trial number. The next-day starting state would be measured after actual sleep and morning activity. Its quarter-unit sample would reduce usable inventory again. Deng retained the familiar rest instruction and no new bodily task. Yue took a short comfortable garden walk and returned before fatigue. She wanted to visit every friend who might be pleased; she kept the smaller plan so tomorrow's actual check would receive a recovered body rather than an exhausted celebration.

reservoir_ep21_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_028.text: On One Thousand Three Hundred Forty-nine, the clinician delivered the actual final post-trial review. No new tissue injury, headache or changed shoulder range was found. Jing's accepted blank settled before the current independent comparison. Seventy-two and a quarter measured usable after ordinary recovered sleep and morning activity before the quarter-unit sample. That withdrawal left seventy-two actually usable, with ninety-two and one quarter percent compatibility. The sample was actually gone. The final next-day result still met the preregistered usable minimum exactly, without rounding a smaller amount upward.

reservoir_exam_next_c.speaker: narrator
reservoir_exam_next_c.text: Mei observed familiar zero-draw grounding and the actual ordinary stop beside the clinician's tissue findings. Balance remained stable within the present check. Four coppers paid the delivered final appointment, completing the twelve-copper formal next-day line for the actual dates Twenty-one, Thirty-five and Forty-nine. All three qualifying trials and all three actual next mornings were now delivered. Yue remained stage seven while Mei prepared the independent full-series decision. The evidence was complete; the certificate had not been issued by the kitchen, a rumor or a candidate's wish to skip its final ordinary review.

reservoir_ep21_030.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_030.text: Jing preserved the final next-day seventy-two separate from the trial's seventy-two and a quarter. Its fresh sample had cost a quarter unit, and no statement about excellent sleep returned it to Yue. The present exact minimum left no room for an unrecorded additional task. Deng retained ordinary rest and familiar settling only. The certificate decision would use the actual dated sequence, including all real sample costs, changed responses and tissue checks. Yue looked at the six completed qualifying dates and felt pride in their exactness rather than a need to find the largest number among them.

reservoir_ep21_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_031.text: Mei arranged the completed sequence in its actual order, leaving the early failed assessments beside the later recovered pairs. The warm failure, movement lag and stopped sleep task had not been erased by success. Paid recovery had separated them from the new series. Each later trial had a recovered starting review, accepted blank, real sample costs, familiar bounded task and full stop. Each next morning had its own current comparison and ordinary tissue check. The record could now show what changed without claim the candidate had always possessed the control she only learned through difficult days.

reservoir_ep21_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_032.text: Deng read only the teaching observations Mei asked him to confirm. He did not sign the independent compatible-portion result or declare his student's stage. His licensed instruction had stayed within the old earned scope. Yue could remember his patience and respect the fact that it was not the certificate's source. The distinction felt less cold now that the evidence was complete. Different people's real work had made this possible, and keeping their responsibilities exact gave her more to thank than a single flattering story about a teacher recognizing hidden greatness.

reservoir_ep21_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_033.text: Jing checked the sample withdrawals against the actually used preparation stock. The three recovered qualifying trials had each consumed a quarter unit across two eighth samples; the three next mornings had each consumed another quarter. That was one and a half actual units sampled across the full qualifying series alone, separate from the three half-unit familiar task costs and earlier practice samples. No final achievement returned any of it. Yue could see the cost of evidence as a real part of the usable reservoir, rather than an inconvenience the successful ending might omit.

reservoir_ep21_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_034.text: The actual dated trial endings were seventy-two and three eighths, seventy-two and a half, and seventy-two and a quarter. Their following mornings, after fresh quarter-unit samples, had left seventy-two and one eighth, seventy-two and a quarter, and seventy-two. All six remained at or above this board's preregistered usable minimum after their real costs. Compatibility and observed balance had also met each stated condition. Mei would not average them into one prettier number. Different actual mornings had supplied different evidence, and the smaller last follow-up was part of the completed result.

reservoir_ep21_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_035.text: An ordinary record clerk asked why the final next-day number was smaller than the movement trial's. Jing showed its actual starting quantity and fresh sample cost, while Mei pointed out the separate condition and date. The clerk had been tempted to replace it with the highest result for a clearer public summary. He accepted the correction and retained the sequence. A public certificate could be readable without pretending a body's inventory stayed constant. Yue liked seeing an ordinary clerical question improve the record before later readers turned a convenient peak into an ability they expected everywhere.

reservoir_ep21_036.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_036.text: The room grew quiet after the checks. Yue had imagined the end of the series as a door bursting open. Instead Mei asked whether the ordinary lamp could be moved because its glare obscured a date. Jing moved it at the low safe table. The independent full-series decision would be prepared for Three Hundred Fifty-four, allowing the actual record review before issue. Yue felt impatient and also grateful for the mundane delay. A title with incomplete or misleading dates would be harder to defend in the ordinary life she intended to carry it into.

reservoir_ep21_037.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_037.text: At lunch Fu asked whether the actual last next morning had been difficult. Yue said the current quantity had met seventy-two exactly after sampling, which made her newly aware of every real cost. Fu heard the number without declaring it unlucky or magnificent. She asked what the examiner had actually accepted. Yue explained the completed condition and pending decision. The ordinary question kept her from turning a boundary value into another invented story about destiny. They ate beans and let an honest small margin remain an honest small margin.

reservoir_ep21_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_038.text: Tian offered to draw a broad margin around the last number for artistic reassurance. Yue refused and accepted a fish instead, provided it stayed on the private scrap. Jing said the fish would also need its own clear scope before advising anybody about margins. They laughed and put the drawing beside the lunch bowl. The joke had no effect on the actual comparison. Yue could enjoy the kindness without accepting a counterfeit extra unit from friends who wanted the ending to feel comfortable. Their company was already something real enough to offer.

reservoir_ep21_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_039.text: On the sound garden path that afternoon, Yue met the pump candidate and heard his own present schedule. He had stopped one condition and would need another funded recovered decision before repeating it. She offered no method beyond her qualified scope or promise that her completed series meant he would also pass soon. He congratulated her on the real work and looked sad about his own delay. Both feelings were possible. She listened to the actual question he wanted to ask his examiner, rather than tell him every disappointment could be repaired by adopting her attitude.

reservoir_ep21_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_040.text: He asked whether she had hated the protected rest days. She admitted she had, especially when the basin managed without her. He laughed because his village well had also continued while he was away. They walked the ordinary path slowly and discussed being useful without being indispensable. The conversation belonged to two candidates whose bodies had paid different real costs. A good result did not make Yue the authority over his next recovered attempt. She could offer company and her own honest experience while his qualified examiner retained the actual decision.

reservoir_ep21_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_041.text: On Fifty, the course household served an ordinary celebratory extra onion from its own accepted kitchen arrangement, not the formal-check reserve now closed. Yue noticed the modest gift because the squash-hating candidate announced an improbable victory for vegetables. The cook accepted no heroic interpretation and said onions had been available at the market. They ate while Tian tried to improve the fish's folded tail. The independent decision was still pending. A pleasant meal could honor completed work before a certificate without claiming the kitchen had issued the stage itself.

reservoir_ep21_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_042.text: Fu's brother sang after he had eaten, retaining the audience condition learned through his own ordinary appetite. Yue listened to the whole song and waited for his actual question before answering. The familiar relationship carried her more comfortably than the uncertain stage label. She had spent months learning useful control in a room, while also learning to stop correcting a friend before he had finished his words. Neither practice replaced the other. The song remained his, the independent examination remained Mei's, and Yue could be grateful for both without making herself their sole purpose.

reservoir_ep21_043.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_043.text: Jing's father brought one late bean and declared it insufficient to feed a celebration. Tian proposed appointing it symbolic chairman. The child demanded it be eaten and defeated the proposal again. Yue laughed and accepted a small shared piece. Its ordinary taste reminded her of the many particular days that had carried the course. A certificate would describe a tested reservoir, not collect ownership of those days or the people who made them. She wanted to leave with permitted notes and completed wages when the time came, while relationships retained their own future choices.

reservoir_ep21_044.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_044.text: Mei joined the ordinary meal briefly and refused to announce the decision before its actual issue date. She could say the qualifying evidence was complete and had met the registered conditions. The full-series certificate would carry the final reviewed source and scope, not a toast. Yue thanked her for the independent work already delivered and said the fixed fee had made the earlier failed results easier to trust. Mei accepted the particular thanks. She would have been paid for an honest unsuccessful examination too, which gave the successful evidence a more durable meaning than approval earned by flattering a candidate.

reservoir_ep21_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_045.text: On the public board, the ordinary clerk posted the accurate current status: three qualifying trials and three next-day checks completed, independent certificate decision pending Fifty-four. He kept the dates clear and the decorative border beneath them. A visitor still asked whether that meant Yue could now heal a sprained wrist. Qiu pointed to the actual scope and answered plainly that this local reservoir examination had tested no healing method. The child's ordinary care remained its own real source. A promising title could not supply an ability merely because a frightened reader wanted it included.

reservoir_ep21_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_046.text: Yue heard the question and remembered the river bank. The paid guard, parent and ordinary clinician had acted while she cleared a low path. Her completed evidence had not changed that past division of work or restored the child's lost painful days. It could help her use her earned small circuit more dependably under ordinary changes. A future different task would require its own qualified clearance. She would need to keep that answer ready after the certificate as well as before it, when refusing an untested demand might sound less impressive than the title.

reservoir_ep21_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_047.text: Qiu brought the proposed later basin terms to the ordinary receiving shelf for owner review, without asking Yue to select today. The public observer option would have limited ratified comparison access and actual finite receiving duties. The maintenance service would have funded ordinary local work and later operating correspondence. Departure would close without a new endorsement or apparatus. The certificate result would not make any agreement compulsory. Yue read the kinds of work and left their detailed offer for its actual appointment after issue. She wanted her next choice to be as concrete as the evidence just completed.

reservoir_ep21_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_048.text: The mother letter stayed private beside the plum-tree drawing. Yue began drafting the final result reply and left its certificate sentence blank. She could already report the third trial and actual next morning, but would not write that the board had issued what remained pending. Her mother had asked whether she ate, not whether she could make a deadline sound victorious. Yue included the garden bean bird and the onion celebration, then folded the draft. The ordinary dispatch would occur after the actual decision, paid from her own received money and carrying no demand for a quick reply.

reservoir_ep21_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_049.text: Deng told Yue to retain ordinary recovery before the certificate appointment. Completing the series did not make every following day suitable for larger input. The final next-day inventory had actually paid its sample and remained seventy-two at that recorded time. Any later current comparison would have its own starting condition and costs. Yue accepted modest familiar practice only within the known ceiling and real rest. She had learned enough from the early failures to know that a satisfying ending could tempt her to ignore ordinary fatigue more efficiently than an obvious threat.

reservoir_ep21_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_050.text: Jing put the final prepared sleeve back in its proper custody after treatment. No instrument had become Yue's reward, and no private water diary had followed her through the examination. The candidate's permitted own notes could describe her actual practice and the public facts approved by their owners. The fuller independent record remained with its named custodian. Yue appreciated the distinction now that she wanted to carry everything that made the work feel real. Some things could remain shared and still belong to the memory she took away.

reservoir_ep21_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_051.text: On Fifty-one, the actual ordinary post-series recovery began with breakfast, comfortable movement and no new application demand. Yue walked the short sound public path with Fu while the basin surface held a pale reflection. Fu asked whether she felt changed. Yue said she felt able to describe what had changed without promise that everything had. The old shoulder range remained. The mother's years remained lost. The quiet useful reservoir had survived three specific changed conditions. Friendship still required hearing a real request before making it better. Fu considered the answer and offered ordinary company rather than another test.

reservoir_ep21_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_052.text: At the public bench a child asked whether the inside reservoir looked like the basin water. Yue said the picture could help someone imagine balance, but her examination had used actual compared quantity and response rather than a pond inside her body. The child thought a pond would be inconvenient anyway because of ducks. Yue agreed. Their ordinary joke kept a metaphor from becoming an untested anatomy claim. She had earned no middle or upper center, no Foundation change and no flight. The real practice was useful within the lower reservoir and known small-circuit scope they had actually assessed.

reservoir_ep21_053.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_053.text: Fu's brother wanted to write a song about the completed series and asked permission before using Yue's name. She agreed to an ordinary personal song if it kept the independent certificate pending and claimed no untested powers. He complained that exactness made rhymes difficult. Yue said he could write about beans instead. He promised to begin with the temperature room and leave shields out entirely. The conversation amused her because a friend could celebrate through art while still ask which part of another person's life she wished public. An affectionate story did not own its subject.

reservoir_ep21_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_054.text: On Fifty-two Jing prepared a modest familiar practice comparison only if Yue's actual recovered condition remained appropriate. Deng retained the old ceiling and full stops, with no new range. The recorded small input sets between the final follow-up and the later certificate would provide a real source for any current usable increase. They would not be counted as the already completed qualifying trials again. Yue performed the agreed finite work and rested. A stage described earned practice; an inventory still needed a present dated measurement rather than a certificate pinned over every future ordinary loss.

reservoir_ep21_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_055.text: That afternoon the ordinary record clerk returned one draft to Mei because a date had been copied as Thirty-four for the changed-sleep trial. It belonged to Forty-eight. The movement record held Thirty-four, and both were actually separate recovered mornings. Mei corrected the draft against its actual signed source before issue. Yue was glad the error was found now. A reader should not have to trust her memory to discover that the three conditions had occurred on distinct dates. Ordinary clerical checking was part of making the final record useful, even after the bodily evidence itself was complete.

reservoir_ep21_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_056.text: At supper the new clerk asked whether correcting the certificate draft made the completed trials uncertain. Yue said the bodies and signed records had their actual dates; the draft needed to reflect them. A copied mistake did not change what happened, and leaving it uncorrected would make later readers misunderstand the sequence. He recognized the difference from ordinary cup returns. Tian declared the fish now qualified in comparative date theory. Jing asked it to retire quietly. Their familiar laughter let an exact correction belong to ordinary life rather than a crisis demanding somebody's infallibility.

reservoir_ep21_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_057.text: On Fifty-three the independent ordinary source review checked all six qualifying dates against their signed condition records. reservoir_ep21_060.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_060.text: Before bed Yue read the complete dated sequence once, then put it away. Three different changed trials had met the local criteria and each had survived its real next morning. reservoir_ep21_061.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_061.text: Fu knocked to return the travel-coat fastening Yue had left at the table. The seam was sound, and no task had been invented for her. reservoir_ep21_062.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_062.text: Jing's father passed below the window complaining that the new bean row had reached its final harvest before anybody praised it properly. reservoir_ep21_063.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep21_063.text: In the quiet she imagined telling her mother the actual result and then answering the familiar question about food. The order pleased her.
